name: product-playbook
description: A phased, principle-driven product-building skill set — guides anyone (newcomer or experienced) through the full product lifecycle, sequential but standalone, with hard-won principles baked into each phase. Anti-scope-creep by design.
author: kish21

install.from: commands/*.md + directory-form commands/<name>/ (SKILL.md + references/) (+ PRINCIPLES.md, VISION.md, templates/PRODUCT.md)

spine: PRODUCT.md (the shared living file each skill reads + appends to)
principles: PRINCIPLES.md (single source, referenced by every skill)

commands.purpose: Guided entry-point — walk the phases one at a time, pausing at each gate
Vision, customer, problem, value — benchmarked to the current-year market
Lock the ONE core feature + explicit OUT-OF-SCOPE list (anti-creep)
Core-first phased plan with a testable exit criterion per milestone
Decide stack + tools + key decisions (2026 OSS-first); ADRs
Clean folder layout + what each folder is for; prompts/ YAML for AI
(UI products) principles → confirmed sample page → archetype-correct DESIGN.md (shadcn tokens)
(UI products) mechanical enforcement of the design-system laws — real OKLCH→WCAG contrast engine + token/motion/font checks; CI-friendly
Walking skeleton that runs: config, logging, infra, tooling, CI
Typed models/schemas/migrations BEFORE logic; agree units across boundaries

Bridge /contracts and /build: decompose each milestone into layer-scoped, independently mergeable tickets (data/service/UI/tests) with exact file paths and a security DoD; or log a single ad-hoc bug against the file that owns it
Per-feature loop with security-in-DoD + per-feature doc + live-path verify
Checkpoint tester: verify exit criteria + security DoD before testing
Is it good? measure-first; separate failures; confidence score
Deep review + security review + reconcile docs + PR + handoff
Success metric + retro + decide next from evidence
Run anytime: scope creep / vision drift / code↔docs drift check
(UI suite, bundled) build/skin ONE React component against DESIGN.md tokens; CSS-vars, interactive states, a11y

notes: Sequential but standalone: run the phases in order, or enter at any skill — each bootstraps context from PRODUCT.md or the existing codebase.
Compose, don't reimplement: skills invoke existing Claude Code skills (/code-review, /security-review, /verify, /run, /doc-create, /doc-audit, /loop, github-pr-flow) rather than duplicating them.
Each skill self-identifies via YAML frontmatter and references PRINCIPLES.md (single source) — no duplicated rule text.

Spine resolution is PRODUCT.md-first but flexible: existing/brownfield projects fall back to CLAUDE.md/README/docs/AGENTS.md, and code-only projects get a clearly-labelled INFERRED read — never a fabricated baseline (PRINCIPLES.md, §Spine resolution).

The 17-skill journey badge counts the phase chain; /new-component is a bundled UI-suite SUPPORT skill (category ui-suite), not a journey phase — it is shipped here so product-playbook installs fully standalone.

Single-master rule for the UI suite (/design-system, /new-component, /frontend-audit): mastered in product-playbook; any copy elsewhere (e.g. product-toolkit) is a one-way synced, read-only copy (playbook → toolkit).
